quantity_shape.answers.q1.angle_change: Quantity {value, unit}; angle units deg or rad, magnitude scored.

task.coordinate_convention: The direction and displacement questions request magnitudes; no clockwise or transverse sign was specified, so equivalent signed reports are compared by absolute value.

questions.request: Find the change in direction of the reflected beam.
Estimate the transverse displacement of the spot on the screen.
Identify the most direct geometric quantity to change if the displacement must fall to one quarter of its original value.

task.statement: A collimated laser beam is incident nearly normally on an adjustable plane mirror. The mirror rotates 0.010 rad about a vertical axis. A viewing screen is normal to the nominal reflected ray, 1600 mm from the mirror along that ray. Neglect higher-order corrections associated with the initial angle of incidence. Report the angle change and spot displacement as magnitudes.
